audit_items.title: Recover safely from abandoned workspace locks
audit_items.acceptance: Add owner-bound, race-safe crash recovery or an OS-managed lease. A killed worker must leave a usable explicit recovery path; a live owner must never be displaced. Test killed-process recovery, PID reuse, concurrent claims, partial journals and exact undo.

audit_items.title: Enforce application-folder separation at the shared operation boundary
audit_items.acceptance: Centralize the overlap guard for mutating operations across CLI, terminal and API; define source-checkout and installed-wheel roots explicitly. Test exact app root, ancestor, descendant and independent sibling workspaces without following links.

audit_items.title: Bind ordinary sorting to the preview confirmed by the user
audit_items.acceptance: Extend reviewed identity/destination receipts to ordinary and combined sorting, or require an explicit separately named live-directory mode. Added, changed or removed inputs and policy changes must require renewed preview without creating state.

audit_items.title: Remove repeated full-catalog reads from sorting and lookup
audit_items.acceptance: Use indexed ID lookup and operation-local title maps with explicit revision/integrity guards. Measure row reads, bytes, elapsed time and memory at increasing collection sizes; retain detection of changed catalogs during apply.

audit_items.title: Reduce application source typing debt without weakening checks
audit_items.acceptance: Start with shared request/result records and mutation boundaries; review behavior before annotation changes. Reduce a declared baseline by module/error class with unchanged regression behavior; no blanket Any, ignores, deleted safeguards or snapshot-only silencing.

audit_items.title: Complete real-model and native-platform qualification
audit_items.acceptance: Continue the existing PAC-015 rather than duplicate it: controlled real local model runs, declared hardware/runtime identities, native console/browser checks and explicit visual-versus-efficacy acceptance. Retain unavailable paths as unverified; do not make user-run testing a prerequisite.

audit_items.title: Verify the declared Python and installation platform matrix
audit_items.acceptance: Run an offline-friendly development matrix over the supported minimum/current Python versions and launch paths, with clean and upgrade installation fixtures and explicit optional dependencies. Keep native-model qualification under PAC-015.

audit_items.title: Make long read-only browser scans cancellable with visible progress
audit_items.acceptance: Route browser discovery, rule review and previews through cancellable jobs with bounded progress, stale-result rejection and explicit read-only semantics. Keep source replacement/undo commit sections non-cancellable and verify shutdown behavior.

audit_items.title: Refresh legacy acceptance evidence without erasing its history
audit_items.acceptance: Review each exact requirement against current sources and execute its missing proof before accepting a fresh report. Preserve historical acceptance and explicit raw-source/model/native limitations; leave unsupported requirements incomplete.

audit_items.title: Replace category-rule syntax fields with guided row editing
audit_items.acceptance: Add selectable per-file assignment controls and structured rule rows with inline errors, preserved slugs on label-only renames, keyboard access and draft/save distinction. Retain CLI syntax and exact preview/consent guards.

audit_items.title: Unify actionable recovery messages across terminal and browser
audit_items.acceptance: Create a shared semantic error catalog with operation-specific recovery actions, retaining sanitized machine codes. Cover lock/history, category ties, unknown original titles, stale plans and rule revision errors without recommending unsafe lock deletion.

audit_items.title: Clarify current documentation versus historical privacy and workflow contracts
audit_items.acceptance: Add precise supersession links and current scope annotations while preserving historical documents verbatim where archival. Current entry documentation must distinguish public exports, generated metadata and private recovery state, with command examples checked against shipping CLI.

audit_items.title: Add reusable path-free publishing recipes
audit_items.acceptance: Version, list, preview, save and select named recipes independently of model paths and approvals. Saving never starts processing; loaded settings remain subject to current validation, explicit consent and per-batch model identity.

audit_items.title: Add workspace storage and recovery health inspection
audit_items.acceptance: Report used/estimated space, filesystem capability results and history status without deleting anything. Any later pruning needs an exact explicit plan, preserves active recovery chains and fails closed on uncertainty. Coordinate crash ownership with PAC-029.

audit_items.title: Add private original-title and category library search
audit_items.acceptance: Add opt-in local search over trusted private titles and category assignments with bounded paging and clear unknown-title states. Keep titles out of public catalogs, PNG metadata, shared packs and default external reports.

audit_items.title: Add artist-directed spatial protection budgets
audit_items.acceptance: Admit a validated mask/budget format, resampling rules and reproducible identity; preview it on the final raster and carry it through quality gates, resume identity and exact output review. Do not claim improved AI resistance without separate controlled evidence.
